fields.summary_ko.0: Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) declined 57% from $140.94 in June to $60.55 on November 3, with a $5,000 investment through end-2030 expected to reach approximately $5,400 (less than 2% annual returns).
fields.summary_ko.1: Adjusted EPS for 2026 is expected to increase to $1.48 (more than 3x the 2025 estimate of $0.42), with data center and AI segment revenue surging 78% in Q3, marking the highest growth rate in 15 years.
